name: Midnight Silk Wrap Dress
description: The Midnight Silk Wrap Dress is a timeless statement piece crafted from luxurious mulberry silk that drapes beautifully against the body. Its adjustable wrap silhouette flatters every figure, while the subtle sheen catches the light with effortless elegance. Perfect for evening events or elevated everyday wear, this dress transitions seamlessly from cocktail hour to a candlelit dinner.
care_instructions: Dry clean only. Store on padded hanger. Steam to remove wrinkles — do not iron directly.
features: Adjustable wrap tie at waist for custom fit
Hidden snap closure at bust for secure wear

name: Brixton Wool-Blend Overcoat
description: The Brixton Overcoat blends classic tailoring with contemporary comfort, featuring a structured shoulder and a slightly relaxed fit through the body. The wool-cashmere blend provides exceptional warmth without bulk, making it an ideal companion for brisk autumn walks and winter commutes. Interior pockets lined in satin keep essentials secure, while the notch lapel adds a polished finishing touch.
care_instructions: Dry clean only. Brush with garment brush after each wear. Store with cedar blocks to prevent moths.
features: Two exterior welt pockets and one interior pocket
Back vent for ease of movement

name: Alpine Cashmere Scarf
description: Wrap yourself in cloud-like softness with the Alpine Cashmere Scarf, woven from the finest Grade-A Mongolian cashmere. Each scarf is individually inspected for quality and features hand-rolled edges that speak to meticulous craftsmanship. Generously sized at 80" x 24", it can be styled as a traditional scarf, a shawl, or even a light travel blanket.
care_instructions: Hand wash in cold water with cashmere shampoo. Lay flat to dry. Fold — do not hang — to store.
features: Grade-A Mongolian cashmere for ultimate softness
Hand-rolled edges for a refined finish
Oversized 80" x 24" dimensions for versatile styling
Comes in a reusable Aurelia & Co. dust bag

name: Côte d'Azur Soy Candle
description: Transport yourself to the sun-drenched French Riviera with the Côte d'Azur Soy Candle. Top notes of bergamot and sea salt give way to a heart of jasmine and white tea, finishing with a warm base of driftwood and amber. Hand-poured in small batches using 100% natural soy wax, each candle delivers up to 60 hours of clean, even burn time.
care_instructions: Trim wick to 1/4" before each use. Burn for at least 2 hours to prevent tunneling. Keep away from drafts.
features: Hand-poured in small batches in the USA
Lead-free cotton wick for clean burn

name: Hearthside Merino Throw Blanket
description: The Hearthside Merino Throw transforms any living space into a haven of warmth and style. Woven from extra-fine merino wool sourced from Australian farms committed to ethical animal welfare, this throw is irresistibly soft against the skin. The generous 60" x 80" dimensions make it perfect for curling up on the couch, and the classic waffle-knit texture adds sophisticated visual interest to any room.
care_instructions: Dry clean recommended. If hand washing, use cold water and wool-safe detergent. Lay flat to dry away from direct sunlight.
features: Extra-fine 19.5 micron merino for itch-free comfort
Self-fringe edges for a handcrafted look

name: Portofino Leather Tote
description: The Portofino Leather Tote is the everyday bag you'll reach for season after season. Crafted from full-grain Italian leather that develops a rich patina over time, it features a spacious interior that easily accommodates a 15" laptop, planner, and daily essentials. The reinforced handles are designed for all-day carry comfort, and the magnetic snap closure keeps everything secure without sacrificing accessibility.
care_instructions: Condition with leather balm every 3-6 months. Wipe clean with a damp cloth. Avoid prolonged sun exposure. Store stuffed with tissue paper.
features: Full-grain Italian leather with natural patina development
Interior zip pocket and two slip pockets

name: Kensington Chelsea Boots
description: The Kensington Chelsea Boots are a modern reimagining of a British classic. Constructed using traditional Goodyear welt technique, they offer durability that lasts decades with proper care. The burnished calfskin leather upper showcases beautiful tonal variation, while the elastic side panels ensure effortless on-and-off wear. A leather-stacked heel and sole provide a satisfying stride on any surface.
care_instructions: Polish with matching shoe cream after every 5-10 wears. Use cedar shoe trees when not in use. Resole when leather sole shows significant wear.
features: Full-grain calfskin upper with burnished finish
Pull tab at back for easy entry

name: Amalfi Linen Button-Down Shirt
description: The Amalfi Linen Shirt embodies relaxed Mediterranean sophistication. Cut from premium European flax linen, it softens with every wash while maintaining its structured collar and clean lines. The relaxed regular fit provides room to breathe on warm days, and the curved hem looks equally polished tucked in or worn loose over chinos.
care_instructions: Machine wash cold on gentle cycle. Hang dry or tumble dry low. Embrace the natural wrinkle — or iron on linen setting while slightly damp.
features: Curved hem for tucked or untucked wear
Single chest pocket with embroidered Aurelia monogram

name: Seraphina Velvet Midi Dress
description: Make an entrance in the Seraphina Velvet Midi Dress, a showstopper crafted from silk-blend velvet that catches the light from every angle. The fitted bodice flows into a gentle A-line skirt that falls gracefully to mid-calf, creating a silhouette that's both flattering and comfortable. A subtle V-neckline and delicate cap sleeves keep the design refined, letting the sumptuous fabric speak for itself.
care_instructions: Dry clean only. Store hanging inside-out to protect the velvet pile. Steam gently on reverse side if needed.
features: Fitted bodice with A-line midi skirt
Hidden back zipper with hook-and-eye closure

name: Elysian Linen Throw Pillow
description: The Elysian Throw Pillow brings effortless Provençal charm to your sofa, bed, or reading nook. Each cover is crafted from stonewashed French linen that has a beautifully lived-in texture from the moment you unwrap it. The generous 22" x 22" size and plush down-alternative insert create an inviting cushion that's as comfortable as it is stylish.
care_instructions: Remove cover and machine wash cold. Tumble dry low. Insert spot clean only.
features: Stonewashed French linen with relaxed, textured hand-feel
Hidden zipper closure for clean lines

name: Highlands Cable-Knit Sweater
description: Inspired by the rugged beauty of the Scottish Highlands, this cable-knit sweater combines heritage craftsmanship with modern luxury. The merino-cashmere blend delivers exceptional softness and warmth, while the intricate cable pattern running down the front and sleeves adds visual depth and texture. A relaxed fit with ribbed cuffs and hem ensures it pairs effortlessly with everything from tailored trousers to weekend denim.
care_instructions: Hand wash cold or use delicate machine cycle in a mesh bag. Reshape and lay flat to dry. Do not tumble dry.
features: Traditional cable-knit pattern on front and sleeves
Ribbed crew neckline, cuffs, and hem

name: Regent Leather Belt
material: Full-Grain Bridle Leather, Solid Brass Buckle
description: The Regent Belt is built to last a lifetime. Cut from a single piece of English bridle leather — the same leather used in premium equestrian tack — it will develop a deep, rich patina with years of wear. The solid brass buckle is hand-polished and features the subtle Aurelia & Co. hallmark on its underside, a discreet signature of quality.
care_instructions: Condition with leather cream annually. Wipe with damp cloth as needed. Allow to air dry if wet — never use direct heat.
features: Solid brass buckle with Aurelia hallmark
3.5cm width — versatile for dress or casual wear

name: Mayfair Tailored Chinos
description: The Mayfair Chinos redefine smart-casual with a modern slim-tapered fit that sits comfortably at the waist and tapers cleanly through the leg. Woven from organic cotton with a touch of stretch, they move with you from morning meetings to evening outings without losing their crisp silhouette. Garment-dyed for a rich, lived-in color that only improves with wear.
care_instructions: Machine wash cold with like colors. Tumble dry low or hang to dry. Iron on medium heat if desired.
features: Organic cotton with stretch for all-day comfort
YKK zip fly with button closure

name: Riviera Leather Sandals
description: The Riviera Sandals capture the essence of a Mediterranean summer in every step. Handcrafted from vegetable-tanned leather that molds to your foot over time, they feature a contoured cork footbed that provides natural arch support for all-day wear. The braided leather strap design adds artisanal character, while the rubber-injected leather sole grips confidently on sun-warmed stone and sand alike.
care_instructions: Wipe clean with a soft damp cloth. Apply leather conditioner to straps periodically. Allow to air dry completely if wet.
features: Vegetable-tanned leather straps — no harsh chemicals
Contoured cork footbed with suede lining

name: Provençal Lavender Candle
description: Bring the calming fields of Provence into your home with this hand-poured lavender candle. Infused with pure lavender essential oil and complemented by hints of eucalyptus and cedarwood, it creates a serene atmosphere perfect for unwinding after a long day. The frosted lilac glass vessel doubles as a decorative accent long after the candle has been enjoyed.
care_instructions: Trim wick to 1/4" before each use. Do not burn for more than 4 hours at a time. Place on a heat-resistant surface.
features: Pure essential oil fragrance — no synthetics
Frosted glass vessel for decorative reuse

name: Claridge Structured Blazer
description: The Claridge Blazer is the cornerstone of a well-curated wardrobe. Tailored from Italian virgin wool with a touch of stretch, it provides a sculpted silhouette that never feels restrictive. Peaked lapels and a single-button closure exude boardroom authority, while the stretch lining allows for comfortable all-day wear. Pair it with the Mayfair Chinos for a coordinated look or throw it over a silk camisole for evening polish.
care_instructions: Dry clean only. Steam to remove wrinkles. Store on a structured hanger to maintain shape.
features: Italian virgin wool with stretch for ease of movement
Two flap pockets and one welt breast pocket
Princess seams for a sculpted fit

name: Savile Bi-Fold Wallet
description: The Savile Wallet is a study in understated refinement. Crafted from supple Italian calfskin, it features a slim profile that slides effortlessly into a front or back pocket without creating bulk. Eight card slots, two note compartments, and a hidden RFID-blocking layer ensure your essentials are organized and protected. The hand-painted edges and tonal stitching reflect the meticulous attention to detail that defines Aurelia & Co.
care_instructions: Wipe with a soft dry cloth. Apply leather conditioner once or twice a year. Keep away from water and direct heat.
features: Full-grain Italian calfskin with hand-painted edges
Presented in an Aurelia & Co. gift box

name: Botanica Silk Camisole
description: The Botanica Camisole is the ultimate layering essential, equally stunning worn alone or beneath the Claridge Blazer. Cut from fluid silk charmeuse, it skims the body with a relaxed fit that's never clingy. The adjustable spaghetti straps and bias-cut construction create a universally flattering drape, while the cowl neckline adds a touch of effortless sophistication.
care_instructions: Hand wash in cold water with silk detergent. Do not wring — press gently in a towel. Hang to dry away from direct sunlight.

name: Atelier Ceramic Diffuser
material: Handmade Ceramic, Natural Reed, Essential Oil Blend
description: The Atelier Diffuser offers a flame-free way to infuse your space with scent. The handmade ceramic vessel houses a blend of amber, sandalwood, and vanilla essential oils that release gradually through natural rattan reeds. Each diffuser lasts approximately 3-4 months, providing a consistent, subtle fragrance that transforms any room into a calming retreat.
care_instructions: Flip reeds every 1-2 weeks to refresh scent. Keep away from direct sunlight to preserve oil quality. Place on a protected surface.
features: Handmade ceramic vessel — each piece is unique
Essential oil blend — no synthetic fragrance
Flame-free and safe for homes with children or pets

name: Corsica Waxed Field Jacket
description: The Corsica Field Jacket is built for the man who values both form and function. The waxed organic cotton shell repels light rain and wind, while the corduroy-lined collar provides a soft layer of warmth around the neck. Four front patch pockets — two at the chest, two at the hip — offer ample storage, and the internal drawcord waist lets you cinch the silhouette for a tailored look on blustery days.
care_instructions: Wipe clean with a damp sponge. Re-wax annually with a wax cotton reproofing bar. Do not machine wash or dry clean.
features: Waxed organic cotton for water resistance
Four front patch pockets with button flaps
Internal drawcord waist for adjustable fit
Two-way YKK zipper with snap storm flap

name: Isabelle Pleated Midi Skirt
description: The Isabelle Skirt features flowing accordion pleats that create mesmerizing movement with every step. Crafted from recycled polyester crepe as part of Aurelia & Co.'s sustainability commitment, it feels silky-smooth and drapes beautifully from an elasticized high-waist band. The midi length hits just below the knee, making it appropriate for office days and weekend brunches alike.
care_instructions: Machine wash cold inside out on delicate cycle. Hang to dry — do not tumble dry. Do not iron directly on pleats.
features: Elasticized high-waist band — no zipper needed
Midi length falls just below the knee

name: Kensington Wool Fedora
description: The Kensington Fedora is the finishing touch every outfit deserves. Made from premium Australian wool felt, it holds its shape beautifully while remaining lightweight enough for all-season wear. The grosgrain ribbon band and pinched crown give it a timeless silhouette, and the 2.5" brim provides just the right amount of sun protection for city strolls and countryside escapes.
care_instructions: Brush with a soft-bristle hat brush to remove dust. Spot clean with a damp cloth. Store on a hat stand or upside-down on crown to maintain shape.
features: Grosgrain ribbon band with Aurelia & Co. pin
Pinched crown with classic teardrop shape

name: Sanctuary Sateen Sheet Set
description: Sleep like you're in a five-star hotel every night with the Sanctuary Sheet Set. Woven from GOTS-certified organic cotton in a lustrous sateen weave, these sheets have a buttery-soft hand that only improves with washing. The set includes one flat sheet, one fitted sheet with deep 16" pockets, and two pillowcases (one for Twin size). Each piece features a delicate hemstitch border for an elegant, hotel-worthy finish.
care_instructions: Machine wash warm with like colors. Tumble dry on low. Remove promptly to reduce wrinkles. Avoid bleach and fabric softener.
features: Lustrous sateen weave with subtle sheen
Deep 16" pockets fit mattresses up to 18"
Hemstitch detailing on flat sheet and pillowcases

name: Palazzo Leather Sneakers
material: Full-Grain Nappa Leather, Margom Rubber Sole
description: The Palazzo Sneakers prove that luxury and comfort are not mutually exclusive. Built on Italian-made Margom rubber soles — the same used by the world's top luxury houses — they provide superior traction and cushioning. The full-grain nappa leather upper is soft from the first wear and ages gracefully, developing a character uniquely your own. A minimalist design with tonal stitching ensures they pair with everything from shorts to a sport coat.
care_instructions: Wipe with a damp cloth after each wear. Use a leather sneaker cleaner for deeper cleaning. Apply white leather protector spray monthly.
features: Italian-made Margom rubber sole for superior grip
OrthoLite cushioned insole for all-day comfort
Gold-debossed Aurelia & Co. logo at heel

name: Ashford Corduroy Trousers
description: The Ashford Trousers bring texture and warmth to your autumn-winter wardrobe. Crafted from organic cotton corduroy with a fine 14-wale construction, they offer a refined look that's a step above standard cords. The tailored slim fit sits naturally at the waist and tapers gently through the leg, creating a clean line that pairs beautifully with the Amalfi Shirt or Highlands Sweater.
care_instructions: Machine wash cold inside-out to preserve corduroy nap. Tumble dry low. Steam or iron on reverse side.
features: Garment-washed for a soft, broken-in feel

name: Montmartre Leather Crossbody
description: The Montmartre Crossbody is the everyday companion for those who prefer to travel light without sacrificing style. Its compact yet surprisingly spacious interior fits a phone, cardholder, keys, and lip balm with room to spare. The adjustable crossbody strap allows you to wear it across the body or over the shoulder, and the pebbled Italian leather resists scratches beautifully — looking just as refined after months of daily use.
care_instructions: Wipe with a soft damp cloth. Condition leather every 3-6 months. Polish brass hardware with a dry cloth.
features: Pebbled Italian leather for scratch resistance
Adjustable strap — crossbody or shoulder wear
Magnetic flap closure with interior zip pocket
Solid brass hardware with antique finish
Fits phone, wallet, keys, and essentials

name: Luna Silk Robe
description: The Luna Robe transforms your morning routine into a ritual of luxury. Crafted from weighty silk charmeuse with a satin finish, it falls just below the knee and moves like liquid with every gesture. The shawl collar and wide self-tie belt create an elegant silhouette, while the interior tie keeps the robe securely closed. A thoughtful Aurelia Rewards favorite and a perennial best-seller for gift-giving.
care_instructions: Hand wash cold or dry clean. Do not bleach. Iron on low heat on reverse side. Store on a padded hanger.
features: 19-momme silk charmeuse — heavier weight for luxurious drape
Shawl collar with wide self-tie belt

name: Artisan Stoneware Vase
description: Each Artisan Stoneware Vase is a one-of-a-kind piece, shaped by hand and finished with a reactive glaze that creates unique patterns no two vases share. Standing 10" tall with a gently tapered silhouette, it's the perfect vessel for a single stem, a small bouquet, or simply as a sculptural object on its own. The weighted base ensures stability, and the waterproof interior makes it fully functional for fresh flowers.
care_instructions: Hand wash with mild soap. Not microwave or dishwasher safe. Handle with care — each piece is handmade and may have slight variations.
features: Handmade stoneware — each piece is unique

name: Greenwich Merino Polo
description: The Greenwich Polo elevates the casual classic to Aurelia & Co. standards. Knitted from extra-fine merino wool, it delivers temperature regulation that synthetic polos simply cannot match — cool in summer, warm enough for a spring evening. The knit collar holds its structure without stiffness, and the slim fit creates a polished silhouette that transitions effortlessly from the golf course to a rooftop dinner.
care_instructions: Machine wash cold on wool cycle. Reshape and lay flat to dry. Do not tumble dry or iron.
features: Extra-fine merino wool — breathable and temperature-regulating

name: Celestia Gold Hoop Earrings
description: The Celestia Hoops are the pair you'll never take off. Crafted with a thick layer of 18K gold over sterling silver, they resist tarnishing far better than standard plated jewelry and are safe for sensitive ears. The 30mm diameter hits the sweet spot — noticeable enough to make a statement, refined enough for everyday wear. A hinged closure clicks securely shut, so you never have to worry about losing one.
care_instructions: Remove before swimming or showering. Store in the provided pouch to prevent scratching. Clean with a soft jewelry cloth.
features: 18K gold vermeil — 2.5 micron gold layer over sterling silver
Hinged click closure for secure wear
Comes in Aurelia & Co. velvet pouch

name: Côte d'Azur Linen Blazer
description: The Côte d'Azur Blazer is summer tailoring at its finest. Unstructured and unlined for breathability, it drapes naturally over the shoulders without the rigidity of a traditional blazer. The Italian linen fabric develops beautiful character over time, and the patch pockets and notch lapels keep the mood relaxed yet refined. Pair with the Mayfair Chinos and Palazzo Sneakers for an effortlessly pulled-together warm-weather look.
care_instructions: Dry clean or hand wash cold. Hang to dry. Iron on linen setting while slightly damp for best results.

name: Marais Marble Tray
description: The Marais Tray elevates everyday moments — from a morning coffee ritual to an evening cocktail arrangement. Carved from a single slab of natural marble, each tray features unique veining that makes it a genuine one-of-a-kind piece. The solid brass handles provide elegant portability, and the 14" x 10" surface area is ideally sized for a vanity, coffee table, or bar cart display.
care_instructions: Wipe with a damp cloth. Seal with marble sealer every 6 months. Avoid acidic substances (lemon, vinegar) directly on surface. Use coasters.
features: Carved from a single slab of natural marble
Solid brass handles with antique finish
Each piece has unique, natural veining

name: Giardino Floral Wrap Dress
description: The Giardino Dress captures the romance of an Italian garden in a wearable work of art. The exclusive floral print — designed in-house by Aurelia & Co.'s textile team — blooms across fluid viscose crepe that moves beautifully with every step. The true wrap construction allows for a customizable fit, and the midi length with a gentle flutter hem adds a playful touch to this otherwise refined silhouette.
care_instructions: Machine wash cold on delicate cycle inside-out. Hang to dry. Iron on low heat on reverse side if needed.
features: True wrap construction for adjustable fit
Viscose crepe for fluid drape and breathability

name: Firenze Acetate Sunglasses
description: The Firenze Sunglasses combine Old World craftsmanship with modern lens technology. Each frame is cut from premium Mazzucchelli acetate — handmade in Italy with rich depth of color that plastic frames simply cannot replicate. The CR-39 lenses provide 100% UV400 protection with superior optical clarity, and the keyhole bridge adds a vintage-inspired detail that flatters a wide range of face shapes.
care_instructions: Clean lenses with the included microfiber cloth. Store in the hard case when not in use. Avoid leaving in hot cars — heat can warp acetate.
features: Mazzucchelli acetate frames — handmade in Italy
Includes hard case, microfiber cloth, and Aurelia pouch

name: Como Cashmere V-Neck Sweater
description: The Como V-Neck is cashmere at its purest — no blends, no compromises. Knitted from Grade-A Mongolian cashmere in a fine 12-gauge knit, it's lightweight enough to layer under a blazer yet warm enough to wear on its own. The relaxed V-neck pairs naturally with both dress shirts and T-shirts, making it the ultimate transitional season staple that earns its place in any discerning wardrobe.
care_instructions: Hand wash cold with cashmere-specific detergent. Gently squeeze — never wring. Reshape and lay flat to dry on a towel.
features: Ribbed cuffs and hem for structure

name: Soho Suede Ankle Boots
material: Italian Suede, Leather Sole with Rubber Insert
description: The Soho Ankle Boots are the ultimate cool-weather staple for women who refuse to choose between style and comfort. The Italian suede upper is butter-soft from day one, while the leather sole with a rubber heel insert provides confident grip on city streets. A comfortable 2.5" block heel adds just the right amount of height, and the inside zip makes getting in and out effortless even on the busiest mornings.
care_instructions: Spray with suede protector before first wear. Brush with suede brush to maintain nap. Avoid wearing in heavy rain.
features: Italian suede upper — pre-treated for stain resistance
2.5" block heel for stable, comfortable height
Leather sole with rubber heel insert

name: Riviera Turkish Cotton Towel Set
description: Wrap yourself in five-star luxury every day with the Riviera Towel Set. Woven from long-staple Turkish cotton at a plush 700 GSM, these towels are exceptionally absorbent yet quick to dry thanks to the cotton's natural hollow fiber structure. The set includes two bath towels (30" x 56"), two hand towels (16" x 30"), and two washcloths (13" x 13"), each finished with a subtle dobby border and the Aurelia monogram.
care_instructions: Machine wash warm. Tumble dry on medium. Do not use fabric softener — it reduces absorbency. Avoid bleach.

name: Capri Striped Linen Dress
description: The Capri Dress is effortless summer dressing distilled to its essence. The relaxed shift silhouette in crisp European flax linen falls just above the knee, and the classic Breton-inspired stripes add a nautical charm that never goes out of style. Side seam pockets — a rarity in dresses — add everyday practicality, and the linen fabric breathes beautifully on the hottest days.
care_instructions: Machine wash cold. Tumble dry low or hang to dry. Iron on linen setting while slightly damp. Linen naturally wrinkles — this is part of its charm.
features: Mother-of-pearl button detail at back neck

name: Artisan Leather Dopp Kit
description: The Artisan Dopp Kit is the travel companion that gets better with every trip. Crafted from vegetable-tanned leather that develops a beautiful patina over time, it features a wide-mouth brass zipper that opens fully for easy packing and access. The water-resistant interior lining protects against spills, and the sturdy leather base keeps the bag upright on any bathroom counter.
care_instructions: Wipe exterior with damp cloth. Condition leather every 6 months. Clean interior lining with a mild soap solution. Air dry thoroughly.

name: Belmont Cashmere Cardigan
description: The Belmont Cardigan is the piece you'll reach for every single day — the one that goes with everything and makes everything look better. Knitted from the same Grade-A Mongolian cashmere as our men's Como V-Neck, it features a relaxed open-front silhouette that layers effortlessly over dresses, blouses, and tees. The dropped shoulder seam and slightly elongated length create a cocooning effect that feels like a stylish hug.
care_instructions: Hand wash cold in cashmere shampoo. Press water out gently with a towel — do not wring. Reshape and lay flat to dry. Store folded with cedar.
features: Dropped shoulder seam for relaxed fit
